name: StationCard
title: StationCard
summary: A partner radio station card: photo, call sign and frequency, an On air or Off air pill, city and languages, what is playing now, and one action.
whenToUse: Use on ISM Radio and Global Bible Network pages to list partner and HD Radio stations.
Use in a grid of 2–4 cards, or one card beside a NetworkMap selection.
whenNotToUse: Do not use for audio Bible chapters; use AudioPlayer.
Do not use for a partner organisation without a station; use PartnerCard.

anatomy.description: Image (150px) → body: head (name, frequency, status pill) → meta rows → now line → action.

props.name: name
props.description: Call sign or station name as the station uses it, e.g. "KISM".

props.name: frequency
props.description: Frequency line in tabular numbers, e.g. "98.7 FM · HD2".

props.name: status
props.description: `onAir` shows the pulsing live pill; `offAir` greys the photo and the pill.

props.name: imageAlt
props.description: Real alt text for the photo, e.g. "A listener wearing headphones".

props.name: languages
props.description: Languages row, joined with " · " by the component.

props.name: nowLabel
props.description: Label before the now-playing text, e.g. "Now:". Omit on off-air cards.

props.name: now
props.description: What is playing now (on air) or when the station returns (off air, in local time).

props.name: actionLabel
props.description: Action label, e.g. "Listen live" or "Past broadcasts".

props.name: actionHref
props.description: Action URL. When omitted a `<button>` is rendered and `onAction` is used.

props.name: onAction
props.description: Click handler for the action (use with a button, or to start audio on press; never autoplay).

props.name: primaryAction
props.description:
Use the Horizon Blue primary button. Only for the one featured on-air station; others use the
secondary button. Off-air cards always use secondary and show ↗.

variantNotes: The card itself uses the `.card` hover and focus from the base layer.

states.universal: See rules/states.md for the seven required states and their hooks.

rules: Live is the `--live` red dot only. Never colour the card, the name or the button red.
Only on-air cards get the Horizon Blue "Listen live" button. In a grid of several on-air cards, keep it to the one featured station and use `.btn-secondary` for the rest.
Name 24px 600; frequency in tabular numbers ("98.7 FM · HD2").
Meta rows: location, then languages separated by " · ". Two rows at most.
Off-air cards say when the station returns, in local time.
Past broadcasts open another page, so they carry ↗.

accessibility: The status pill has visible text ("On air" / "Off air"); the dot is `aria-hidden`.
The station photo has real alt text; meta icons are `aria-hidden="true"`.
"Listen live" starts audio only on press; never autoplay.
Each card is an `<article>`; if the grid has a heading, make card names part of the outline as needed.
content: Call sign or station name as the station uses it ("KISM", "Radio Vida").
Now line: "Now: The Gospel of John, read aloud".
Off air: "Back on air at 6:00 am local time".
Station names, frequencies and schedules shown in the preview are samples.
